# RAR fixtures

Copied from https://github.com/markokr/rarfile/tree/master/test/files on 2026-09-14.
Copyright Marko Kreen; ISC license reproduced in LICENSE. Fixture password is
`password`; these archives contain upstream synthetic test data, not user files.
RAR3 is the pre-RAR5 format used by RAR4 tools. Tests cover RAR3/RAR5 solid, RAR5
CRC, encrypted data and encrypted headers, plus Unicode names.
